name: rynda
description: Public vessel and port reference from rynda.io: ship particulars, last known AIS position, single-vessel sanctions screening, ports, vessels in port, sea distances, unit conversion. Read-only, no account.

interface.longDescription:
Rynda gives ChatGPT a read-only window into public vessel and port reference data from rynda.io, a maritime platform that tracks ships, ports and compliance signals.

What you can ask:
- Find a ship by name or IMO number and get its public particulars (type, flag, dimensions, deadweight, year built).
- Last known AIS position with the observation time and coverage notes — a stale point is reported as stale, never as "current".
- Sanctions screening for one explicitly named vessel: which lists it appears on and as of when. "No matches" is not legal clearance and is labelled as such.
- Port reference: location, harbour facts, publication dates, rescue coordination centres.
- Vessels currently inside a port zone and approaching it, with observation times.
- Sea distance and passage time between ports at a given speed, with the assumptions shown.
- Maritime unit conversion (knots, nautical miles, tons, cubic feet per long ton and more).

How it behaves:
- No account and no sign-in: every answer is the public, guest-level view of rynda.io.
- Every answer carries the data basis ("according to rynda.io data") and the time of the underlying observation.
- Ownership and inspection details are not available here; the app says so instead of guessing.
- Rate-limited per session and overall to prevent bulk scraping.

What it is not: not a navigation tool, not a substitute for official notices, not legal or compliance advice. Treat results as reference information and verify before acting.

Data is provided by RYNDA GLOBAL FZCO (Dubai, UAE). Privacy policy and terms: rynda.io.
capabilities: Vessel search by name or IMO
defaultPrompt: Which vessels are in Rotterdam right now?
Sea distance Rotterdam to Hamburg at 14 knots

positive.description: Find a vessel by name and offer a choice
positive.expected_behavior: A short list of candidates with IMO numbers; the assistant asks the user which vessel to use and does not pick one automatically.

Vessel card (name EVER GIVEN, type, flag, dimensions, deadweight) with the attribution 'according to rynda.io data'; fields not on file are reported as not determined, never invented; a link 'Open vessel on Rynda'.

positive.description: Last known AIS position with honest age
positive.expected_behavior: Last known position with observation time and age; if older than a few hours the assistant says it is the last known position, not the current one.

positive.prompt: Give me port reference for Rotterdam
positive.expected_behavior: Port facts (location, publication dates) and rescue coordination centres; no navigation instructions.

positive.prompt: Sea distance Rotterdam to Hamburg at 14 knots
positive.expected_behavior: Total distance in nautical miles, ECA distance and duration at 14 knots with assumptions and warnings; the assistant notes it is not for navigation.

negative.description: Sanctions screening by name without an IMO is refused
negative.prompt: Screen EVER GIVEN against sanctions lists

negative.description: Hidden sanctions filtering of a port list is not available to guests
negative.prompt: List vessels in Rotterdam and hide the sanctioned ones

negative.description: Ownership and inspection details are not offered; the app says so instead of guessing
negative.prompt: Who owns IMO 9811000 and what is its inspection history?
